reason: Sequencing of UTI (N39.0 + B96.20) vs acute metabolic encephalopathy (G93.41) as principal. Both were present on admission and both were treated. The provider listed UTI as principal, which I followed, but encephalopathy could arguably be sequenced first because it drove the admission. This changes the DRG. The pyelonephritis question (cystitis vs early pyelo) was never resolved. Sepsis was explicitly ruled out.
